description: Finish the Strava OAuth integration to automatically upload completed rides to Strava with token refresh, background sync, and upload status feedback.

phases.name: Core OAuth & API Implementation
phases.description: Implement real OAuth token exchange and Strava API HTTP calls

subtasks.title: Implement Strava OAuth token exchange
subtasks.description: Replace mock token exchange in DefaultOAuthHandler.handle_callback() with real HTTP POST to https://www.strava.com/oauth/token using oauth2 crate. Exchange authorization code for access_token, refresh_token, and expires_at.
acceptance_criteria: OAuth token exchange makes real HTTP request to Strava
Returns proper TokenResponse with access/refresh tokens
Handles error responses from Strava API
subtasks.notes: Implemented real OAuth token exchange with Strava. Added StravaTokenResponse and StravaErrorResponse structs for API response parsing. Replaced mock tokens with actual HTTP POST to https://www.strava.com/oauth/token using reqwest. Handles network errors, API errors, and token parsing properly. Committed as 7b33bd1.

subtasks.title: Implement token refresh functionality
subtasks.description: Implement DefaultOAuthHandler.refresh_token() to POST to Strava's token endpoint with refresh_token. Handle expired refresh tokens by requiring re-authorization.
acceptance_criteria: Refresh token makes real HTTP request
Updates stored tokens with new values
Returns error if refresh token is invalid/expired
subtasks.notes: Implemented real Strava token refresh in DefaultOAuthHandler.refresh_token(). Added refresh_strava_token() helper method that POSTs to https://www.strava.com/oauth/token with grant_type=refresh_token. Handles expired/invalid refresh tokens by detecting error codes (invalid, expired, revoked) on refresh_token field and returns AuthorizationRequired for re-authorization. Added 3 unit tests for error cases. Committed as 2846efe.

subtasks.title: Implement secure credential storage with keyring
subtasks.description: Complete KeyringCredentialStore implementation using keyring crate. Store encrypted tokens in OS credential store (Windows Credential Manager, macOS Keychain, Linux Secret Service).
acceptance_criteria: Tokens stored securely in OS keyring
Can retrieve stored tokens after app restart
Can delete tokens when user disconnects
subtasks.notes: Implemented complete KeyringCredentialStore using keyring crate 2.0. Features: 1) store_tokens() serializes TokenResponse to JSON and stores in OS keyring, 2) get_tokens() retrieves and parses stored JSON back to TokenResponse, 3) delete_tokens() removes credentials from keyring (handles NoEntry gracefully), 4) has_credentials() checks keyring with cache for fast synchronous lookups. Added StoredTokenResponse struct for JSON deserialization with RFC3339 date parsing. Added Mutex-protected credentials cache for performance. Includes 8 unit tests for serialization/deserialization and platform key generation. Committed as dc8cd9e.

subtasks.title: Implement Strava activity upload API
subtasks.description: Complete StravaClient.upload_activity() with real HTTP multipart form upload to POST /uploads endpoint. Handle async upload processing with upload_id.
acceptance_criteria: FIT file uploaded via multipart form POST
subtasks.notes: Implemented real Strava activity upload via POST /uploads endpoint. Added reqwest multipart feature for form file uploads. Created StravaUploadResponse/StravaApiError structs for API responses. Upload creates multipart form with FIT file, data_type, external_id, optional name and description. Handles 401 Unauthorized (TokenExpired), 429 rate limiting, and other API errors gracefully. Returns SyncRecord with upload_id in external_id field for async status polling. Added 3 unit tests for error handling and response deserialization. Committed as 157c77f.

subtasks.title: Implement upload status polling
subtasks.description: Complete StravaClient.check_upload_status() to GET /uploads/{id} and parse processing status. Handle Ready (success with activity_id), Error (with message), and Processing states.
acceptance_criteria: Returns UploadStatus::Ready with activity_id on success
Returns UploadStatus::Error with message on failure
subtasks.notes: Implemented real Strava upload status polling via GET /uploads/{upload_id} endpoint. Returns UploadStatus::Ready { activity_id } when processing completes, UploadStatus::Error { error } when processing fails (e.g., duplicate activity), or UploadStatus::Processing when still pending. Handles 401 (TokenExpired), 429 (rate limit), 404 (not found), and other API errors gracefully. Added 4 unit tests for response deserialization and error handling. Committed as 020e5a8.

subtasks.title: Implement athlete profile fetch
subtasks.description: Complete StravaClient.get_athlete() to GET /athlete endpoint and parse response into AthleteProfile struct.
acceptance_criteria: Fetches real athlete profile from Strava
Parses id, username, firstname, lastname, profile image
subtasks.notes: Implemented real Strava athlete profile fetch via GET /athlete endpoint. Added StravaAthleteResponse struct for API response deserialization. Parses response into AthleteProfile with id, username, firstname, lastname, profile_medium. Handles 401 Unauthorized (TokenExpired), 429 rate limiting, and other API errors gracefully. Added 4 unit tests for response deserialization including full response, minimal response with null fields, and extra field handling. Committed as 25ca8a2.

subtasks.title: Implement Strava deauthorization
subtasks.description: Complete StravaClient.deauthorize() to POST to /oauth/deauthorize endpoint and clear local credentials.
subtasks.notes: Implemented real Strava deauthorization via POST /oauth/deauthorize endpoint. POSTs with bearer token auth, always clears local token regardless of API response (ensures user can disconnect even with network issues). Handles 401 Unauthorized (token already invalid/revoked) and 429 rate limiting gracefully. Added 2 unit tests for error handling and token clearing behavior. Committed as 0b53879.

phases.name: Sync Service & Auto-Upload
phases.description: Create background sync service for automatic ride uploads and retry handling

subtasks.title: Create SyncService struct with platform manager
subtasks.description: Create a new SyncService that manages platform connections, token refresh scheduling, and upload queue. Implement as async actor with message passing.
acceptance_criteria: SyncService created with async task lifecycle
Exposes public API for connecting/disconnecting platforms
subtasks.notes: Created SyncService with async actor pattern using tokio mpsc channels. Implemented SyncServiceHandle for public API with methods for connect, disconnect, queue_upload, retry_upload, cancel_upload, get_sync_records, and update_config. Service manages platform connections (Strava first), loads stored credentials on startup, and provides upload queue infrastructure. Added comprehensive unit tests. Committed as f91d2e5.

subtasks.title: Implement automatic token refresh scheduler
subtasks.description: Add background task that checks token expiry and proactively refreshes tokens before they expire (e.g., 5 minutes before expiry).
subtasks.notes: Implemented automatic token refresh scheduler with background task that checks every 60 seconds. Features: 1) Proactively refreshes tokens 5 minutes before expiry (TOKEN_REFRESH_BUFFER_MINUTES), 2) Retry logic with 30 second delay between attempts (REFRESH_RETRY_DELAY_SECS), 3) Maximum 3 consecutive failures before requiring re-authorization (MAX_REFRESH_FAILURES), 4) SyncEvent enum for UI notifications (TokenRefreshed, TokenRefreshFailed, ReauthorizationRequired, PlatformConnected, PlatformDisconnected), 5) TokenRefreshState tracking per platform for failure count and last attempt time, 6) Event subscription via SyncServiceHandle.subscribe_events(). Added 5 unit tests for constants, state tracking, and event handling. Committed as b71e113.

subtasks.title: Implement ride completion hook for auto-upload
subtasks.description: Add hook in ride recorder that triggers sync after ride completion when auto_sync is enabled. Export to FIT format and queue for upload.
acceptance_criteria: Ride completion triggers upload if auto_sync enabled
Upload queued even if network unavailable
subtasks.notes: Implemented ride completion hook for auto-sync. Added: sync service handle to RideRecorder, platform config storage, set_sync_service() and set_platform_config() methods, is_auto_sync_enabled() helper, trigger_auto_sync() method that exports to FIT and queues uploads in background. Modified save_ride() to call trigger_auto_sync(). Committed as a56c66d.

subtasks.title: Implement upload queue with persistence
subtasks.description: Create upload queue that persists to database. Handle offline scenarios by queuing uploads and retrying when online.
acceptance_criteria: Offline detection and retry on reconnect
subtasks.notes: Implemented persistent upload queue with offline scenario handling. Created sync_store.rs with StoredUploadQueueEntry struct, CRUD operations, retry tracking, and FIT file storage helpers. Integrated SyncStore with SyncService including spawn_with_db(), load_pending_uploads_from_db() on startup, and automatic persistence. Added connectivity detection with periodic checks and automatic queue processing on reconnect. Implemented exponential backoff retry mechanism with MAX_UPLOAD_RETRIES=5. Added new SyncEvent variants for upload lifecycle and connectivity changes. Committed as 6909ccd.

subtasks.title: Implement upload status tracking in database
subtasks.description: Create sync_store.rs to manage sync_records table operations. Track upload status (Pending, Uploading, Completed, Failed), external_id, and error messages.
acceptance_criteria: Update status with external activity URL
subtasks.notes: Implemented comprehensive sync_records table operations in sync_store.rs. Added SyncRecordStatus enum (Pending, Uploading, Completed, Failed) with string serialization. Added StoredSyncRecord struct with status, external_activity_id, external_activity_url, error_message, retry_count, uploaded_at, and created_at fields. Implemented CRUD operations: create_sync_record, get_sync_record, delete_sync_record. Added query methods: get_sync_records_by_ride (for sync history per ride), get_sync_records_by_platform, get_sync_records_by_status, get_pending_sync_records, get_failed_sync_records. Added status update helpers: mark_sync_uploading, mark_sync_completed (with external activity ID), mark_sync_failed (with error message). Added utility methods: is_ride_synced, get_latest_sync_record, get_sync_record_count_by_status. Added 12 comprehensive unit tests covering all operations. Updated mod.rs exports with SyncRecordStatus and StoredSyncRecord (renamed hardware_store's version to HwStoredSyncRecord to avoid conflict). Committed as 6629395.

subtasks.title: Implement failed upload retry mechanism
subtasks.description: Add retry logic for failed uploads with exponential backoff. Track retry_count and cap at maximum retries. Allow manual retry trigger.
subtasks.notes: Implemented comprehensive retry logic for failed uploads with exponential backoff. Added: 1) UploadRetryQueued event for manual retry notifications, 2) Enhanced handle_retry_upload() with max retry check (2x automatic limit), database persistence, load from DB fallback, and immediate queue processing trigger, 3) SyncStore methods (reset_for_retry, get_failed_entries, get_retry_count, increment_retry_count), 4) Unit tests for retry functionality. Committed as abf4144.

subtasks.title: Handle edge cases and error scenarios
subtasks.description: Handle edge cases: duplicate uploads, network timeout, Strava API errors, invalid FIT files, revoked tokens during upload.
subtasks.notes:
Implemented comprehensive edge case handling for Strava sync:

1. New error variants in SyncError:
   - DuplicateActivity: When activity already exists on platform
   - InvalidFitFile: When FIT file is malformed or corrupted
   - Timeout: When request times out with duration
   - RateLimited: When API rate limit is exceeded

2. FIT file validation (strava.rs):
   - validate_fit_file() checks header size, signature, and minimum size
   - Validation runs before upload to fail fast with clear errors
   - Supports both 12-byte and 14-byte FIT header formats

3. HTTP timeout configuration:
   - DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECS (60s) for regular API calls
   - UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_SECS (120s) for file uploads
   - Connect timeout of 30 seconds

4. Duplicate activity detection:
   - is_duplicate_error() helper detects duplicate messages
   - DuplicateActivity error returned during upload
   - UploadStatus::Duplicate variant for status polling
   - Duplicates treated as success (activity exists)

5. Token expiry handling during upload:
   - TokenExpired triggers ReauthorizationRequired event
   - User-friendly message guides user to reconnect
   - Upload marked as failed (non-retryable)

6. User-friendly error messages via get_user_friendly_error_message()

7. Improved is_retryable_error() categorization

8. Comprehensive unit tests for all edge cases

Committed as 1e79af1.
